_meta.purpose: Machine-readable legal requirements for the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and related Legal Metrology Act requirements used by the inspection engine.
_meta.authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
source_priority: official Department of Consumer Affairs publications and gazette notifications
other government reproductions of the rules
secondary legal sources only for discovery, never as final legal authority
_meta.decision_policy: The rule engine must never infer PASS from missing evidence. If a legal condition cannot be established from available evidence, return UNCERTAIN or REVIEW_REQUIRED.
_meta.legal_boundary: This file is an implementation dataset, not legal advice. Current amendments must be audited by the Legal/Domain Lead before authoritative use.
notes: Unit sale price is governed by Rule 6(11), not Rule 12.
Wholesale-package declarations are governed by Rule 24; Rule 27 concerns registration of manufacturers, packers and importers.
Rule 8 is not a generic 'all declarations must be printed in one block' rule. Principal Display Panel treatment must respect Rule 2(h), Rule 8 and applicable amendments.
Rule 26 small-pack treatment is an exemption/relaxation and must be evaluated before ordinary retail declaration checks.
Rule 32 is a penalty/fine provision, not a commodity-specific labelling rule.
Visual measurement from an ordinary photograph is not automatically a verified physical measurement.

requirements.description: Determine whether the commodity is a pre-packaged commodity within the meaning of the Act and Rules.
Packages sold directly to industrial or institutional consumers are outside the ordinary retail-package declaration path, subject to the exact statutory/rule conditions.

decision.pass_when: package is in scope for the applicable LMPC chapter
decision.uncertain_when: scope, sale channel or exemption facts are not established

rules.legal_note: Do not encode unverified quantity thresholds as automatic legal exemptions until the current consolidated text and amendments have been checked.

requirements.description: Where applicable, retail packages inside a group, combination, multi-piece or gift package must retain the declarations required for the retail packages.

decision.pass_when: all applicable package-level declaration obligations are evidenced
decision.uncertain_when: inner packages are not visible or package structure cannot be established

requirements.description: Commodity specified in the Second Schedule must be packed in a specified standard quantity, unless the applicable rule permits another treatment.
Where permitted to use a non-standard size, the package must carry the prescribed prominent non-standard-pack declaration.

decision.pass_when: quantity matches an applicable prescribed standard or the required non-standard declaration is evidenced
decision.fail_when: a scheduled commodity violates an applicable standard-pack requirement
decision.uncertain_when: schedule membership or applicable current schedule entry cannot be established

requirements.description: Name and address of manufacturer, packer or importer, as applicable.
Country of origin for imported products.
Common or generic name of the commodity.
Net quantity in the applicable standard unit of weight, measure or number.
Month and year of manufacture, packing or import, as applicable.
Best-before or use-by declaration where applicable.
Retail sale price in the prescribed MRP form, inclusive of all taxes.
Consumer care details.
Dimensions of the commodity where required, including differing dimensions of different pieces where applicable.
Unit sale price in the applicable standard unit.

decision.pass_when: every conditionally applicable required declaration is evidenced and passes its specific validation
decision.fail_when: a required declaration is evidenced as absent or demonstrably non-compliant
decision.uncertain_when: the package may contain the declaration but image/evidence coverage is insufficient

rules.legal_note: Mandatory-field applicability is conditional. Do not treat every optional/conditional field as universally mandatory.

requirements.description: The e-commerce entity must display the applicable mandatory declarations, subject to the rule's allocation of responsibility and exceptions.

decision.pass_when: applicable declarations are displayed as required
decision.uncertain_when: listing evidence or responsibility allocation is unavailable

requirements.description: Unit sale price must be declared on the principal display panel in the prescribed standard unit and rounded to the nearest two decimal places, subject to applicable exceptions.

decision.pass_when: declared unit sale price equals the deterministically calculated value within the prescribed rounding rule
decision.fail_when: declared unit sale price is absent where required or numerically inconsistent
decision.uncertain_when: MRP/net quantity/unit price cannot be reliably extracted or applicable exception cannot be established

requirements.description: Determine the applicable principal display panel area using the package-shape rule.

decision.pass_when: PDP area is determinable under the applicable shape rule
decision.uncertain_when: package geometry or physical dimensions cannot be established reliably

rules.clause: Rule 7(2), Table I and applicable provisions

requirements.description: Required minimum numeral height is determined from the applicable PDP area band.
Numeral/letter width must meet the prescribed width-to-height relationship, subject to the stated exceptions.

measurement_policy.VERIFIED: requires a calibrated or otherwise validated measurement path
measurement_policy.ESTIMATED: may support review but must not be represented as metrologically verified
measurement_policy.UNCERTAIN: must not produce a definitive PASS/FAIL measurement conclusion

decision.pass_when: measured height meets the applicable threshold and measurement is verified
decision.fail_when: verified measurement is below the applicable threshold
decision.uncertain_when: measurement is estimated/uncertain or PDP band cannot be established

requirements.description: Every declaration required under the Rules must appear on the principal display panel, subject to applicable provisions.
The area surrounding the quantity declaration must be free from printed information above and below by at least the height of the numeral in the declaration.
The area surrounding the quantity declaration must be free from printed information to the left and right by at least twice the height of the numeral in the declaration.

decision.pass_when: required declarations are evidenced on the applicable PDP and the quantity-declaration clearance requirement passes where measurable
decision.fail_when: verified placement or clearance requirement is violated
decision.uncertain_when: PDP boundary, declaration location or clearance cannot be reliably established

rules.legal_note: Do not encode a blanket requirement that every declaration must be physically grouped into one printed block. Rule 2(h) and related provisions permit specific treatment of pre-printed and online information.

requirements.description: Retail sale price may be indicated on the crown cap, bottle, or both, in the form permitted by the rule.

decision.pass_when: the specific Rule 8(2) conditions are verified
decision.uncertain_when: commodity category or returnable-bottle status is not established

rules.legal_note: Do not generalize this exception to packaged drinking water or other bottle categories without a verified applicable legal provision.

requirements.description: Name and address of manufacturer or importer, or packer where manufacturer/importer is not the packer.
Identity of the commodity contained in the package.
Total number of retail packages or net quantity in standard units, as applicable.

decision.pass_when: all applicable Rule 24 declarations are evidenced
decision.fail_when: a required wholesale declaration is demonstrably absent or incorrect
decision.uncertain_when: wholesale status or package structure is unclear

rules.legal_note: Rule 27 is not the wholesale-package declaration rule. Rule 27 concerns registration.

requirements.description: An export package must be re-packed or relabelled in accordance with Chapter II before sale in India, subject to the rule.

decision.pass_when: required repacking/relabeling for India sale is evidenced
decision.fail_when: an export package is sold in India without required compliance treatment
decision.uncertain_when: India-sale status or export-package status is not established

requirements.description: Packages within the Rule 26(a) exemption threshold may be exempt from the Rules, subject to the provisos and exclusions.
The applicable proviso requires maximum retail price and net quantity declarations for packages in the 10g to 20g or 10ml to 20ml range.

exclusions.description: The Rule 26(a) small-pack exemption does not apply to tobacco and tobacco products.
The Rule 26(a) small-pack exemption does not apply to pan masala.

decision.exempt_when: verified Rule 26(a) exemption applies after exclusions are evaluated
decision.partial_requirements_when: package falls in the applicable 10g-20g or 10ml-20ml range
decision.uncertain_when: quantity or excluded-category status is not established

requirements.description: The Rules do not apply to a package containing fast food items packed by a restaurant, hotel or the like, subject to the exact rule wording.

decision.uncertain_when: packer type or product category is unclear

requirements.description: Applicable scheduled/non-scheduled formulations covered by the specified drug price-control regime may be outside the Rules, subject to the current provisos.

decision.uncertain_when: drug status or applicable price-control coverage is not established

rules.legal_note: Medical devices must not be automatically treated as exempt. Current DoCA material specifically addresses medical-device treatment.

requirements.description: Manufacturer, packer or importer subject to the rule must apply for registration within the prescribed period and comply with registration requirements.

decision.pass_when: registration evidence is present where the inspection scope includes registration
decision.uncertain_when: registration evidence is outside the inspection dataset

rules.legal_note: Keep registration checks separate from package-label declaration checks.

requirements.description: Advertisement mentioning retail sale price must also declare the net quantity or number of the commodity.
Font size of net quantity in the advertisement must meet the applicable Rule 31 requirement relative to retail sale price.

decision.fail_when: required advertisement declaration is absent or demonstrably non-compliant

requirements.description: Rule 32 provides a fine for contraventions for which no other punishment is provided.

decision.pass_when: not a compliance requirement for package labelling; handled as consequence metadata

rules.legal_note: Do not use Rule 32 as a commodity-specific declaration rule. It belongs in the enforcement/consequence layer.

requirements.description: Compare declared net quantity with the current applicable Second Schedule standard quantity.
Where the Rules permit a non-standard size, check the required prominent non-standard-size declaration.

decision.uncertain_when: current schedule membership or amendment state is unknown
